Thus the customer is asking about reimbursement process and has a file number. This is a claim follow-up: they have an existing claim? The email mentions file number. They are asking about procedure: "c'est a moi a payé les frais hôpital pour me les rembourser après ?" So they want to know if they need to pay. So likely CLAIM_FOLLOWUP. Not a new claim because they already have a dossier. It's a claim follow-up.

Thus category: CLAIM_FOLLOWUP.
